findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (D) After coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD.

1) A food handler was observed to don gloves without hand washing. 2) A food handler was observed to drink from a beverage can and not change gloves/ wash hands prior to continuing food service. The situation was discussed with the PIC and they were instructed to review hand washing procedures and timing with all staff. Ensure that hand washing and glove use is consistently completed in manners that are required by the code.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

On arrival there was not a sanitizer ready for use in the C-store kitchen. The PIC was asked about the situation and prepared a solution during the inspection to correct. Ensure that a sanitizer is available in the food preparation areas at all times that foods re being prepared.

findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.citation_text:
3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT.

The ice machine in Caribou Coffee has the scoop used for retrieving the ice observed laying down with the handle in contact with the ice. The PIC was shown and instructed to re-iterate storage practices for this equipment. It is HIGHLY suggested that employees utilize the scoop holder in the equipment that is intended for this purpose moving forward. The scoop was moved to the holder during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

The hand sink by the three part sink in the C-store is without soap at the time of this inspection. The PIC was shown and refilled the dispenser to correct the immediate violation. Ensure that all hand sinks are properly supplied at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

On arrival the sani bucket in the Caribou Coffee shop did not register on the inspector’s test strips. The PIC was shown and had the bucket remade during this inspection to correct. Ensure that all in use sanitizers are maintained at effective concentration at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple nozzles on the fountain drink machines are in need of cleaning. The PIC was shown and instructed to have them cleaned. The nozzles were removed and washed to correct. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are cleaned regularly enough to prevent accumulation of filth.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

The gas station side of the permit is without a ready for use sanitizer. Foods are observed being prepared. The PIC and employee were consulted and instructed to have a sanitizer ready for user at all times that foods are being handled/prepared. A bucket was prepared during this inspection to correct the immediate violation.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

The hand sink in the back area of the C-Store next to the three part sink is observed blocked by a cart. Education was conducted and the cart removed to correct.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).  

1) Raw eggs are stored over raw bacon in the C-Stores walk in cooler. 2) Raw eggs were also observed stored on top of a container of bread in a reach in cooler. Storage orders were discussed with the PIC and they were instructed to review storage practices with employees. The eggs were moved during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The sani buckets in Caribou did not register on the inspector test strips. The buckets were remade during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple nozzles on the fountain drink machines are in need of cleaning. The PIC was shown and stated that they should be cleaned each night. The nozzles were removed and washed to correct.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time. 

Two one gallon containers of milk are observed in the reach in cooler opened and without date markings. PIC and employees were educated and the milk discarded to correct.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions. 

Several flies are observed around the drain under the hand sink in Caribou. PIC indicated that they had a compound for cleaning the drains from an issue in the main building and would use that to remove the issue. This may work, if not though pest control should be contacted for help. Follow up to take place in two weeks.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

The floor drain under the hand sink in Caribou is missing half of the drain cover. Repair/replace so that solid objects and foods do not fall into the drain.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Kitchen handsink observed without signage reminding employees to wash their hands. Inspector provided sign to be posted.
6-301.14: A sign or poster that notifies FOOD EMPLOYEES to wash their hands shall be provided at all HANDWASHING SINKS used by FOOD EMPLOYEES and shall be clearly visible to FOOD EMPLOYEES. [C]

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Items in the hot holding grab & go observed below 135F: fried rice at 117F, pasta dish at 134F, and cheeseburger at 127F, all probed. Ensure all hot held foods are kept at 135F or above. CORRECTED— Discussed with PIC. Foods voluntarily discarded.
3-501.16: (A) (1) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 135F or above. Roasts can be maintained at 130F or above. [P]

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
Provide a thermometer for the drawer cooler. (Inside an empty pan or another place in the food storage portion of the cooler.)
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
1st REPEAT: Seal bare wood around the sneeze guard at the hot dog rollers. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
1st REPEAT: The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training.
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. [C]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Staff observed to don gloves without washing hands first. Staff must wash hands after any activities that may have contaminated hands before donning gloves or beginning food handling. CORRECTED— Discussed with PIC, who will provide education to staff.
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands. [P]

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Boxes in the convenience store storage area observed stored directly on the floor. Discussed proper storage with PIC. Storage will be rearranged so that foods and single service items are at least 6 inches off the floor.
4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed. [C]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.citation_text: 4-101.19  (C) Observed utensils stored on damp cloth in the C-store prep area. Air dry utensils on drainboard or other corrosion-resistant, nonabsorbent and smooth surface.  Reference 4-101.19.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 (P) Quaternary ammonium sanitizer measured 0 ppm in sanitizer bucket at Caribou Coffee. Maintain concentration at 200 ppm to 400 ppm as indicated on manufacturer's label. Reference 4-501.114. 
CORRECTED- Bucket was remade to correct concentration.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11  (Pf) Food employee dumped liquid foods in the hand sink in the coffee area. Hand washing sink must be used for handwashing only. Reference 5-205.11.
CORRECTED- PIC was informed to only use handsinks for handwashing. Drain coffee in prep sinks. Inspector provided handwashing sign.
